methodHandling.otherMethods: Not checked; any method behaves like GET.

query.name: deckId
query.invalidBehaviour: missing/empty -> 400 'deckId is required'; non-UUID -> Postgres error in ownsDeck -> 500 'Internal error'; unknown/foreign UUID -> 403 'Not your deck'

checkOrder: 4. readJobState (blob 'deck-jobs' job/{deckId}.json, normalized from legacy {A,B} shape)

responses.when: deck owned but no job-state blob yet
responses.cite: status.ts:15. Note: NO masterApplied / masterSkipReason keys in this branch.

<slideNumber as string key>.error: string — key present only when set
<slideNumber as string key>.url: '/api/image?deckId={deckId}&slide={n}&v={current}' — key present ONLY when status==='done' (otherwise omitted, never null)
<slideNumber as string key>.current: integer: vs.current, else max(versions.v), else vs.version, else 1
<slideNumber as string key>.versions: [{v:int, instruction:string|null}] — stored versions; or synthesized [{v:1,instruction:null}] for a done slide without versions; [] otherwise

bodyShape.done: boolean: every slide status is 'done' or 'error' (true for zero slides)

quirks: `url`, `error`, `status` and `masterSkipReason` are OMITTED (not null) when undefined, because JSON.stringify drops undefined. openapi/api.md show null.
The pre-state body has no masterApplied key.
Legacy blobs storing {A:{...},B:{...}} per slide are collapsed to A on read (_shared/jobState.ts:59-73).
The url's v uses currentVersion, so a reverted slide's url points at the reverted version.
A phantom slide can appear after /api/refine on a slide number that does not exist in the deck (refine.ts:35-36 inserts it into the job state), changing the progress total.
Each call does one Supabase query + one Blobs read; polled every 2s by the frontend.
